prose:
TestingCatalog collects unusually strong code-generated animation and SVG examples that testers attribute to an unannounced Claude Opus 5.6, sometimes accessed through a label called Opus 5.5 Extra. The article describes a possible limited experiment rather than an announced release.

The publication itself says it cannot verify the underlying model identity, and the examples are selected social posts, not a controlled benchmark. Screenshots and author labels cannot establish which weights served a request, an official launch date or universal access. No account was tested, media comparison independently scored or code executed.
highlights: Anthropic announcement is absent in the article
Tester labels include Opus-next and 5.5 Extra
No account or executable sample was tested
